entries.zh: 合乎道理；说得在理（论事切中事理）
entries.en: to hit upon reason; to be right in one's reasoning

entries.zh: 切合时机；恰中节骨眼（抓住合适的机会）
entries.en: to hit the joint; to seize the right occasion or moment
to hit the mark; to hit the bull's-eye

entries.zh: 科考及第；乡试名列前茅（经魁）
entries.en: to succeed in the examination; to come out at the top of the classics examination (jingkui, top rank among the juren)

entries.zh: 开运吉利；好兆头（事情开头顺遂）
entries.en: a good omen; to get off to a lucky start
entries.notes: H「威實」非经见复合词，义主要依 L「buen aguero／buen acierto al principio」推定，字形待校。

entries.zh: （船上）舀水，把舱里的水排出去
entries.en: to bail water out (of a ship)
entries.notes: 首行括注为划除的废弃注记（accidentalmente, quiere decir: acaso），本条实义取「Achicar el agua」，与 H「打水」相合。

entries.en: to brighten, to give light; to clear up (of the sky)

entries.notes: H 栏原标〔疑:霰/散〕；M「Soẫ」与 R「zān」对音均指向「散」，故按「散」立义。

entries.en: to disperse and open up; to clear (of the sky)
entries.notes: H 首字形标〔疑:霰/散〕，据 M「Soẫ」、R「zān」定为「散」；「散開」即云散天开。

entries.en: to make clear, to clarify; to understand clearly

entries.zh: 随时变通；顺时就势（随遇而安）
entries.en: to adapt oneself to the time and circumstances; to accommodate oneself

entries.zh: 妇人随夫安于卑贱（嫁夫随夫，甘处低微）
entries.en: (of a wife) to abide with her husband in a humble station

entries.zh: 妇人随夫而贵（嫁夫随夫，同享尊荣）
entries.en: (of a wife) to share in her husband's honour and exaltation
entries.notes: L 栏为承前省略号，义随上条「acomodarse la muger」。

entries.zh: 安分知足；惜福（随遇而安，爱惜自己的福分）
entries.en: to be content with one's lot; to cherish one's blessings

entries.zh: 辅佐；协办（在公务、差事上从旁相助）
entries.en: to assist, to second (in office or work)

entries.zh: 陪侍；陪同（上司或居官者）
entries.en: to attend upon; to accompany (a superior or person of rank)

entries.zh: 陪侍点名；陪同到班（点卯时在旁伴同）
entries.en: to attend (a superior) at the roll-call or muster
entries.notes: 「陪點」非常见词，按明清官署点卯（点名）之制推为陪侍到班，义项待他证。
